stemMarkdown: An arithmetic progression has first term 13 and common difference 12. Find the average of its first 15 terms. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: For evenly spaced terms the average is the midpoint of the first and last. The last term is $13 + 14 \times 12 = 181$, so the average is $\dfrac{13 + 181}{2} = 97.0$.
